events.failure: The first documents-skill display exceeded the output budget before EOF.
events.recovery: Reread the exact skill in two bounded numbered windows through its final line.

events.failure: The workspace dependency loader reported that the app tool was unavailable through the dynamic surface.
events.recovery: Do not mutate the managed runtime or add another package; inspect already installed renderers and use an existing local PDF path.

events.failure: A broad dependency-tool catalogue projection returned unrelated long plugin descriptions and exceeded the display budget.
events.recovery: Stop broad discovery and probe only the exact existing Edge and Poppler executable paths needed for PDF rendering and raster review.

events.failure: The first final-preparer launch wrapper used an invalid timeout-field token and JavaScript parsing stopped before any shell process or filesystem action.
events.recovery: Correct only the wrapper field name and invoke the already AST-checked file-backed preparer once.

events.failure: The first OP026 correction stopped after partially updating four JSON overlays because a redundant prose replacement anchor had already been transformed earlier in the same in-memory edit loop.
events.recovery: Inspect exact partial state, then use an idempotent reconciliation that normalizes event identifiers, counts, prose, cards, and baton hashes instead of replaying the partial script.

events.failure: The first partial-state read completed, but the orchestration wrapper referenced an undefined output variable and suppressed its attributable result.
events.recovery: Repeat only the read-only scalar projection with the correct result variable and retain the original wrapper fault at zero credit.

events.failure: The first idempotent repair used a case-sensitive prose anchor that did not match lowercase text after a semicolon and stopped before writing prose or baton.
events.recovery: Normalize the JSON overlay separately, use exact bounded file patches for prose, and regenerate only the baton digest/index after the text patch.

events.failure: A multi-file apply-patch was rejected atomically because the generated one-line HTML did not match the assumed line boundary.
events.recovery: Inspect the exact serialized Markdown, HTML, and baton fragments, then run one file-backed reconciliation with exact replacement-count assertions.

events.failure: The first Windows Edge invocation detached and left LASTEXITCODE unset, so the wrapper reported failure even though the PDF was created.
events.recovery: Inspect the exact output and process state, retain the false-negative wrapper, and use hidden Start-Process with Wait and PassThru for later renders.

events.failure: The first original-detail image review appeared to clip the page two title and page four opening text.
events.recovery: Retain the PDF and rasters, adjust pagination conservatively, and require a second visual and coordinate review.

events.failure: The first pagination adjustment produced a second raster with the same apparent original-detail clipping.
events.recovery: Remove fixed section height and render independent page sections before merging.

events.failure: The first third-render raster wrapper misspelled an output cmdlet and stopped before pdfinfo or pdftoppm.
events.recovery: Use standalone directory creation and invoke metadata and raster commands separately.

events.failure: The first raster recovery assumed the parser-rejected pipeline had created its directory, but the directory was absent.
events.recovery: Probe exact path state, create the absent directory once, and resume only pdfinfo and pdftoppm.

events.failure: The second CSS pagination adjustment produced byte-identical rasters, showing that CSS alone did not alter the apparent preview behavior.
events.recovery: Render all four sections independently and merge four verified one-page PDFs.

events.failure: The discovered Poppler directory had pdfinfo and pdftoppm but no pdftotext executable, so the first coordinate probe could not start.
events.recovery: Use the already installed pypdf text visitor to inspect complete fragments and transformation coordinates without another package.

events.failure: The first split-page merged PDF passed coordinate and resized-image review but encoded the pre-diagnostic final counts.
events.recovery: Archive that PDF externally, synchronize all final counts and baton text once, and render one final PDF through the proven split-page path.
